snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

sources.name: Stress Biology submission guidelines (read in a browser)

csl_style.title: Springer Basic (author-date)
csl_style.note: Stress Biology has no style of its own in the CSL repository. Springer Basic (author-date) follows the reference examples on its guidelines page; check the result.

requirements.quote: Articles should be no more than 9,000 words with 8 tables and figures in the main text.

requirements.rule: At most 8 tables and figures in the main text
requirements.quote: Articles should be no more than 9,000 words with 8 tables and figures in the main text.

requirements.rule: At most 250 references, as recent as possible
requirements.quote: References are limited to 250 and should be as recent as possible.
Please provide an abstract of 150 to 250 words.
Please provide 4 to 6 keywords which can be used for indexing purposes.
Cite references in the text by name and year in parentheses.
Use the automatic page numbering function to number the pages.

requirements.rule: A 'Statements and Declarations' section before the reference list
requirements.quote: The following statements should be included under the heading "Statements and Declarations"

requirements.rule: Competing interests statement in the Declarations
requirements.quote: Review articles therefore require a disclosure statement.

requirements.rule: Figures go within the body of the text
requirements.quote: Figures should be submitted within the body of the text.

requirements.rule: Figure files named Fig1, Fig2...; EPS for vector, TIFF for halftones; halftones at least 300 dpi; RGB
requirements.quote: Name your figure files with "Fig" and the figure number, e.g., Fig1.eps.

requirements.rule: At most three levels of headings
requirements.quote: Please use no more than three levels of displayed headings.

requirements.rule: No Word field functions (citations from Zotero or EndNote are fields; Mendeley Cite uses content controls)
Plain font such as 10-point Times Roman
requirements.quote: Use a normal, plain font (e.g., 10-point Times Roman) for text.

requirements.rule: Title page: authors, affiliations with city and country, corresponding author e-mail, ORCID if available
requirements.quote: Please make sure your title page contains the following information.

requirements.rule: Acknowledgments in a separate section on the title page
requirements.quote: Acknowledgments of people, grants, funds, etc. should be placed in a separate section on the title page.

requirements.rule: Use of a large language model is documented in Methods (copy editing does not need declaring)
requirements.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section

requirements.rule: Supplementary files are called "Online Resource" in the text and named ESM_1, ESM_2...
requirements.quote: Refer to the supplementary files as “Online Resource”

requirements.rule: Captions in the manuscript text, starting with "Fig." and the number in bold, no full stop at the end
requirements.quote: Include the captions in the text file of the manuscript, not in the figure file.
